text: Here's what one app gives back to a church, every single week.
cap: What one app gives back to a <mark>church</mark>, every week

text: Most churches today: announcements copied into five group chats. Prayer requests on scraps of paper. And nobody notices when a member quietly stops coming.
cap: Group chats · paper notes · <mark>members slipping away</mark>

text: Now picture one home for the whole church. Services, sermons, events and the Bible, on every phone.
Post an announcement once, and every member is notified. No more copy and paste.
Sermons land in the app by themselves, so anyone who missed Sunday can catch up.
Prayer requests come in privately, and the prayer team sees every one.
And the part that matters most. It shows who hasn't been seen in three weeks, so a leader can reach out before they drift away.
Members tap to say they're coming, so you know how many to expect.
Add it up. Hours of typing given back every week. Members who feel seen. And a pastor with time for people, not a phone.
